integrity: Proof, constructions and tests self-contained; finite experiments supplement but do not establish the all-n theorem; historical novelty is self-review, not independently certified.
limitations: Finite labelled total orders and nonempty families of nonempty neighbourhoods; persistent valuations and one available propositional letter; not a statement for arbitrary posets or order-varying neighbourhood functions.
title: Exact semantic quotient and two-neighbourhood compression on finite intuitionistic chains
